rationale: After 33 minutes in the position, price tested the $13.01 session high and failed to break out, forming a double top. The last five 1-minute candles show steady lower highs followed by a breakdown below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.94) on expanding selling volume (67,682 shares on the latest bar), invalidating the tight consolidation breakout thesis. Exiting now near breakeven preserves capital rather than holding into accelerating downside momentum toward the $12.82 stop.
